user.title: Add RF bridge
user.description: Uses Home Assistant's existing MQTT connection.

data_description.topic: The Tasmota default is tele/rf_bridge/RESULT. MQTT wildcards + and # are supported.
data_description.json_path: Simple dotted path, for example RfReceived.Data.

protocol.title: Configure the default protocol profile
protocol.description: These defaults decode DS-4 / Generic Contact Sensor messages such as 6F620A into device ID 6F62 and event 0A. Adjust them if your sensors use another format.

onboarding.title: Add your RF sensors
onboarding.description: Configured during setup: {sensors}. Scan live MQTT traffic, add a sensor manually, or finish and add sensors later from Configure.

menu_option_descriptions.scan: Listen for RF signals and build a list of identified devices.
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Enter a known RF device ID.
menu_option_descriptions.finish: Create the bridge with the configured protocol and sensors.

scan.title: Scanning for RF sensors
scan.description: Trigger each physical sensor at least once while the scan is running.

scan_error.title: MQTT is unavailable
scan_error.description: Home Assistant could not subscribe to the configured topic. Check the MQTT integration and bridge topic.

scan_empty.title: No matching RF sensors found
scan_empty.description: No signals matched the configured protocol. Trigger a sensor while retrying, verify the MQTT topic, or add its RF ID manually.

scan_results.title: Identified RF devices
scan_results.description: Found {found} unique device(s). Select one to configure, or scan again to keep growing the list.

onboarding_sensor.title: Create identified sensor

manual.title: Create sensor manually
manual.description: Enter the exact RF device ID extracted by the configured protocol.

error.mqtt_unavailable: Configure and connect Home Assistant's MQTT integration first.
error.invalid_profile: Check the profile positions, lengths, and event codes. Codes must be unique hexadecimal values with the configured event length.
error.invalid_rf_id_length: The RF ID length must match the protocol profile.
error.already_configured: This RF ID is already configured.

progress.scan_signals: Scanning MQTT for {seconds} seconds… Identified {found} device(s).

learn.title: Scan and learn RF sensors
learn.description: Choose a protocol, then trigger one or more physical sensors during the scan.

learn_wait.title: Scanning RF signals
learn_wait.description: Trigger every sensor you want to identify. Valid device IDs are accumulated instead of stopping at the first signal.

learn_results.title: Identified RF devices
learn_results.description: Found {found} unique device(s). Select one to create, or scan again to keep growing the list.

learn_empty.title: No matching RF sensors found
learn_empty.description: No signal matched the selected protocol. Retry while triggering the sensor, or create it manually.

learn_done.title: Confirm learned sensor

delete_sensor.title: Delete sensor
delete_sensor.description: This removes the sensor's entities and device after reload.

unknown.title: Recent unknown RF signals
unknown.description: Select a signal to create a sensor.

unknown_create.title: Create sensor from signal

information.title: Information

error.invalid_rf_id_length: The RF ID length must match the selected protocol profile.
